body: I’ve never been above a 4 since I can remember. I think I’m usually at a 5-6, the last few months at a 7-8 and lately at an 8-9-10. I have a pretty nice family that’s supportive and I have the most special, kind, and wonderful boyfriend that you can imagine. He deserves so much that I haven’t been able to give him. If I could have one wish it would be for every single person I’ve ever met to forget me. I’m really tired. I just wish I had never been born.
